DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所欄で、ご不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about the address field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の方が郵便を受け取りやすいので、勤務先を書こうとしました。ここはそれでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所欄の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's easier to receive mail at my company, so I was going to write my workplace. Is that all right here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what the address field means. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは居住住所を確認する欄です。勤務先とは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field is for confirming your residential address. Please keep it separate from your workplace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分が住んでいる所を書くんですね。会社には住んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先を書こうとした理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should write where I live. I don't live at the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you were going to write your workplace. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。居住住所を確認できる資料をご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please prepare a document that confirms your residential address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの資料に自宅の住所があります。その住所を記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 居住住所との違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This document shows my home address. I'll enter that address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the difference from your residential address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 郵送先についての希望は、別に担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please discuss any preferences about the mailing address separately with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。郵便の都合で居住住所を変えて書かず、郵送先の相談として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅の情報を資料で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't change my residential address just for mail convenience; I'll raise it as a mailing-address request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your home information in a document. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自宅の住所を資料どおり書きました。郵送方法は担当の説明を聞いてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 郵送の希望は別に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written my home address as shown in the document. I'll decide about mailing after hearing the person's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss your mailing preference separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。記入した居住住所と資料を照合してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We'll compare the residential address you entered with your document and assist you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the price tag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。大きく二百円、小さく二百十六円とあります。どちらで払うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 値札の二つの数字を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says two hundred yen in large print and two hundred sixteen yen in small print. Which amount do I pay?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the two numbers on the price tag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二百円は税抜、二百十六円が税込の表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Two hundred yen is before tax, and two hundred sixteen yen is the tax-inclusive price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きい数字だけ見ていました。会計では二百十六円なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きい方だけ見ていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was only looking at the large number. So I pay two hundred sixteen yen at checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you were only looking at the larger number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この商品一個の税込価格です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, that's the tax-inclusive price for one of this item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二個なら税込表示の二倍で考えます。四百円だけ用意すればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 税込の会計価格を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: For two, I'll calculate twice the tax-inclusive price. I thought I only needed four hundred yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the tax-inclusive checkout price. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な金額を税込価格でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the amount you need using the tax-inclusive price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一個だけにします。予算の中で他の商品も買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 買う個数の合計を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll just buy one today. I'd like to buy other things within my budget too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consider the total for the quantity you are buying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。一個は二百十六円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. One is two hundred sixteen yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その価格を確認しました。一個をかごへ入れて、レジの金額も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 税込価格で予算を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked that price. I'll put one in my basket and check the amount at the register too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Set your budget using the tax-inclusive price. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。税込価格をご確認いただけましたので、レジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Now that you've checked the tax-inclusive price, please take it to the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図の現在地は、ここになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your current location on the map is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予定が早まり、散歩を終えて外へ出たいです。入口まで全部戻る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中から退出したい理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My plans have moved earlier, so I'd like to finish my walk and leave. Do I have to go all the way back to the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you want to leave partway through. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の位置からは、西側の出口が近くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: From where you are now, the western exit is closer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この池の西側ですね。まだ周回の半分なので、そのまま回るより短いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近い出口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's west of this pond, right? I'm only halfway around the circuit; is it shorter than continuing around?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the nearest exit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この分岐から西へ抜ける道を使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You can take the path heading west from this junction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。周回の矢印について行かず、分岐で出口の方へ曲がります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の現在地を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't follow the circuit arrows; I'll turn towards the exit at the junction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your current location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出口へ出ると、道路沿いの歩道へつながります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you go through the exit, it connects to the pavement along the road.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者に散歩を短くすると連絡し、西出口から出ることを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周回を続けない経路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll contact my companion to say I'm shortening the walk and leaving through the west exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm a route that does not continue around the circuit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。出口名も伝えると分かりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Giving the exit name will make it easier to understand too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡できました。池の西側の分岐から西出口へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者に短縮を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've contacted them. I'll head for the west exit from the junction west of the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your companion you are shortening the walk. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。この地図をお持ちになり、西出口の表示を確認してお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Take this map and follow the signs for the west exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いつご利用になる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: When are you planning to travel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今度の日曜日です。この表の九時発で乗り換えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 利用日を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This coming Sunday. I'd like to make a connection using the nine o'clock departure on this timetable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your date of travel. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その表は平日用です。日曜日は隣の休日の表をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That timetable is for weekdays. For Sunday, please look at the holiday timetable beside it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日が平日なので、この表で日曜も計画していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見ている表の区分を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Since today is a weekday, I was using this timetable to plan Sunday too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask which category the timetable you are viewing is for. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 休日の九時台は、発車時刻が少し違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The departures during the nine o'clock hour are slightly different on holidays.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらでは九時十分ですね。乗り換え先の時刻も休日で見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日曜には別表だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one says nine ten. I'll also recheck the connecting service using the holiday timetable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that Sunday uses a separate timetable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。最初の列車だけ変更せず、接続も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Don't just change the first train; check the connection as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 接続は九時四十分でした。平日の九時半とは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 接続時刻を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The connection is at nine forty. That's different from nine thirty on weekdays.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Recheck the connection time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休日の時刻をメモしておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It would be helpful to note down the holiday times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日曜の出発九時十分、接続九時四十分に直しました。この案内を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日曜の経路を予定に入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've changed it to depart Sunday at nine ten and connect at nine forty. I'll use this information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add Sunday's route to your plans. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。利用当日も運行案内を確認してお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the operating information on the day of travel as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a certificate, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。前に取った物があるので、これを会社へ出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手元の証明書を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have one I obtained before, and I'd like to submit it to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the certificate you have. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先は発行日について何か指定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the recipient specify anything about the date of issue?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 発行から三か月以内、とあります。この証明書は半年前の物でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先の有効期間の指定を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says within three months of issue. This certificate was issued six months ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the recipient's validity-period requirement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その指定なら、手元の発行日は期間の外になりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Under that requirement, the issue date of your copy falls outside the period.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所が同じでも、発行日の条件は別なんですね。今の指定で新しく取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発行日と提出日を比べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even though my address is the same, the issue-date requirement is separate. I'd like a new one that meets the current instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the issue date with the submission date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 種類と記載項目も確認して申請してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the type and information to be included when applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名称と記載項目は会社の案内にあります。来週提出するので、今発行する物を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新規発行が必要か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The name and required information are in the company's instructions. I'll submit it next week, so I'll use one issued now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm whether a newly issued certificate is needed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申請用紙をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll give you an application form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要な項目で一通申請します。古い物は今回の提出用と混ぜずに保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定に合う時期で申請する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll apply for one copy with the required information. I'll keep the old one separately so it doesn't get mixed up with this submission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Apply at a time that meets the requirement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記入内容を確認して、新しい証明書の申請を受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check your entries and accept your application for a new certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 既往歴の欄について確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask about the medical history field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。意味が分からず、今日の症状をもう一度書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既往歴の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I didn't understand it, so I wrote today's symptoms again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what medical history means. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前にかかった病気や、治療を受けた経歴についての欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's for illnesses you've had before and your history of treatment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の症状とは別なんですね。五年前に入院しましたが、病名の日本語が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の症状を書いていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's separate from my current symptoms. I was hospitalized five years ago, but I don't know the disease's name in Japanese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you had written today's symptoms there. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる範囲で、時期と治療を受けたことをお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write the time and the fact that you received treatment, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五年前に一週間入院したと書きます。古い書類は家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 過去の治療歴を分かる範囲で伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write that I was hospitalized for one week five years ago. The old documents are at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your past treatment history as far as you know. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診察で、その書類があることもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: During the consultation, also mention that you have those documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。病名を推測して書かず、入院した時期と期間を記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 病名不明の経歴を補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't guess the disease name; I'll enter when I was hospitalized and for how long.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add details of a medical history whose disease name you do not know. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日の症状は、こちらの別の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Today's symptoms go in this other field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日のことと五年前のことを分けました。不明な病名は診察で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在と過去の欄を分けて記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've separated today's situation from what happened five years ago. I'll explain during the consultation that I don't know the disease name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Enter the present and past in separate fields. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。その区別で担当へ問診票を渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll pass the questionnaire to the person responsible with that distinction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような電話についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of phone calls are you asking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一週間ほど、同じ番号から無言電話が続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 無言電話の経過を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: For about a week, I've been getting repeated silent calls from the same number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain how the silent calls have been occurring. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのくらいの回数で、どんな時間帯ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: How often, and at what times of day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一日二、三回、夜九時以降が多いです。出ても声が聞こえません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 頻度と時間帯を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two or three times a day, often after nine at night. Even when I answer, I can't hear a voice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the frequency and time period. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 脅す言葉などがあったわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So there haven't been any threatening words or anything like that?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。誰かも分かりません。知人かもしれないという想像だけで、名前は言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内容がないことを明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I don't know who it is either. I can only imagine it might be an acquaintance, so I can't give a name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that nothing has been said. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録は残っていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 着信履歴があります。出た回と、出なかった回をメモで分けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着信履歴を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the incoming call history. In my notes, I've separated the calls I answered from those I didn't.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your incoming call history. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が記録と経過を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible will check the records and what has happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号、回数、時刻を見せ、言葉はなかったと伝えます。相手の名前を決めつけず相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録と実際に起きたことを分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the number, frequency, and times, and explain that nothing was said. I'll ask for advice without assuming the caller's identity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss the records and what actually happened separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記録を見ながら、実際にあった電話の経過を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll look at the records while asking about the calls that actually occurred.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱の中身をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what's inside this box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷蔵と書かれた食品です。普通の荷物として出していいか、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷蔵表示の食品だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's food marked “keep refrigerated”. I'd like to ask first whether I can send it as an ordinary parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the food is marked for refrigeration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 温度の条件がある品物ですね。利用できる方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the item has temperature requirements. I'll check the available methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明日、友人に受け取ってもらいたいのですが、普通に送れば明日届くと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通常発送でよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like my friend to receive it tomorrow, but I thought sending it normally would mean it arrived tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether ordinary shipping is acceptable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 到着日と温度の扱いは、それぞれ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The arrival date and temperature handling each need to be checked separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。中身の保存表示と、相手の住所を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取日の希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'll show the storage instructions on the contents and the recipient's address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your preferred receipt date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できるサービス、受付条件、到着見込みをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain the available services, acceptance requirements, and estimated arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それを聞いてから決めます。冷蔵表示のまま常温の発送へ進めないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用可能なサービスと条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll decide after hearing that. I want to avoid proceeding with room-temperature shipping while the food is marked for refrigeration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about available services and conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱の状態も確認しますので、まだ受付はお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also check the condition of the box, so please wait before having it accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は発送を確定せず、条件が合う方法があるか説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認まで受付を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't confirm shipping now; I'll wait for an explanation of whether there's a method that meets the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait to have it accepted until the conditions are checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示と送り先を確認し、選べる方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the label and destination and explain your options.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about the bank transfer recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。請求書と違う口座へ送るよう、今日メールが来ました。名義も違っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの振込先があると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Today I received an email telling me to send money to a different account from the invoice. The account holder's name is different too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show that there are two transfer destinations. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 請求元に変更を確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you confirmed the change with the issuer of the invoice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。メールの新しい口座を入力する前に、銀行で正しいか確認できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 急な変更連絡だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Before entering the new account from the email, I'd like to ask whether the bank can check if it's correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you received sudden notice of a change. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは、請求元の変更依頼が正当かは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't determine here whether the issuer's request for a change is legitimate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、元から知っている会社の電話番号へ連絡します。メール内の番号だけを使わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀行だけでは請求の正当性を確認できないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll call the company using the telephone number I've known from before. I'll avoid using only the number in the email.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the bank alone cannot verify the legitimacy of the request. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 請求元に、変更の有無と正式な情報を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please confirm with the issuer whether there has been a change and what the official information is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。請求書とメールを見ながら、口座名義の違いも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既知の請求元へ確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll look at the invoice and email and ask about the difference in account holder names too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to confirm with the invoice issuer you already know. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が取れてから、振込先をお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have confirmation, decide which account to transfer to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は送金を待ちます。請求元から確認できた情報で、改めて振り込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認が取れるまで送金を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait before sending money today. I'll make the transfer later using information confirmed by the issuer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait to send money until you have confirmation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今は入力を取り消し、資料をお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. For now, cancel the entry and take your documents home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をまとめてお会計しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I ring up these items together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別々にお願いします。友人と一つのかごを使ったので、品物が混ざっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別会計を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Separately, please. My friend and I used one basket, so our things are mixed together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for separate payment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会計前に分けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you separate them before checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。牛乳とパンと卵の三点が私の分です。先にこちらへ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一つのかごに混ざっていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The milk, bread, and eggs are my three items. I'll put them out here first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your items are mixed in one basket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 残りがご友人の分ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The rest belong to your friend, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。間にこの仕切りを置き、私の三点からお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の品を先に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll put this divider between them; please start with my three items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your own items first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お客様分は三点で、この金額です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your three items come to this amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三点と金額を確認しました。私の分だけ払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の品と境目を作る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've checked the three items and the amount. I'll pay only for mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Create a boundary between your friend's items and yours. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらのレシートはお客様分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. This receipt is for your items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の三点とレシートを持って、詰め台へ移ります。友人の会計は別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の点数を確認して払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take my three items and receipt and move to the packing counter. My friend's checkout is separate, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your item count and pay. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。お客様分は完了しました。残りは、ご友人のお会計として進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11221-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Your checkout is finished. We'll process the rest as your friend's purchase.
